the character-based model is the best modeling unit for sequence-to-sequence speech recognition on Mandarin Chinese.
the character based model is the most promising modeling unit for Mandarin Chinese ASR task with the Transformer, and the lexicon free model is more effective than the lexicon related model.
the modeling units of characters are the optimal choice on Mandarin Chinese AS-R tasks using sequence-to- sequence attention-based models with Transformers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the modeling unit choice is still an important factor in sequence-to-sequence speech recognition tasks and the Transformer is a strong baseline for future research.
